verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a live llms.txt at docs.moss.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with structured Moss Docs content). A second llms.txt at moss.dev/llms.txt indexes pages such as the CLI docs, and pages are also published as markdown (e.g. pricing.md), so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-friendly docs. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content dump, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs.
